core_meaning.primary_meaning: Nazeef is an Arabic-origin name meaning “Clean, pure, spotless”.
core_meaning.literal_meaning: The name is the Arabic word itself, used unchanged as a given name rather than a derived or diminutive form.
core_meaning.meaning_explanation: Nazeef corresponds to the Arabic form نَظِيف (Arabic root ن ظ ف (n-ẓ-f); نَظِيف (Naẓīf)). Its core sense is clean, pure, spotless. Nazeef is Arabic نَظِيف (Naẓīf) 'clean, pure, spotless', from the root ن ظ ف (n-ẓ-f). CRITICAL SOURCE ERROR: the source gave نزيف (a different form); the correct form is نَظِيف. The source gloss 'Gifted, Generous' is unsupported and has been replaced with the lexical sense. Same name as nazif.
